profile.title: The person behind Rhino Inquisitor
intro: My name is Thomas, Head of Commerce at Forward. I help teams translate business goals into practical Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud implementation choices — from platform architecture to migration planning and long-term maintainability.
Outside client work, I share field-tested guidance here on Rhino Inquisitor: open source tooling, deep technical articles, and practical advice for developers, architects, and commerce leaders.
